title: Access Control & Sharing in Cloud Warehouses

scenes.line1: Who gets to see your data?
scenes.say: Who gets to see your data in the cloud—and how is sharing actually secured?

scenes.label: Granular
scenes.sub: Cloud warehouses use roles and permissions for fine-grained access.
scenes.say: Cloud warehouses use roles and permissions for fine-grained access control.

scenes.title: Granting Access in Snowflake
scenes.say: For example, in Snowflake, you grant read access to a table by assigning the analyst role.
To share data: choose your dataset, assign roles with the right permissions, and share securely—no data copying needed.

scenes.question: What's the best access strategy?
scenes.say: Interview trap: Don’t give everyone broad access. Always use least-privilege roles and permissions.
